scope.responsibility: Translate the administrative review of field-created clients/pools, preserving the captured review, approval request, recovery and original evidence

before.outcome: The original page did not load cw-i18n.js; waiting for the actual language selector failed at the unchanged 7000ms limit.
With the normal engine loaded but before localizing the panel, the reload label remained Atualizar fichas instead of Refresh records.

preparationCorrections.outcome: Presentation, quota and stale-request scenarios passed. Full-client comparison rejected the legitimate existing PENDING_REVIEW to ACTIVE transition. The final test requires the exact expected approved client, including ACTIVE, original financial fields and actual reviewer/date.

New group passed (13713ms); old intake UI timed out (25677ms) waiting for Portuguese after the new test changed the shared administrator language. The subsequent API test returned 401 instead of injected 503 (3968ms); its separate cause was not established. Equipment flow passed (9179ms).
preparationCorrections.resolution: New language test now creates its own administrator instead of changing the shared QA administrator preference. A fresh isolated run of the new group followed by both unmodified intake regressions passed. No application/backend change, assertion removal, sleep, automatic retry or increased timeout used.

markers: PASS five languages/320/390/1440, literal client/pool fields, missing data, pending/reviewed states, links, immutable nodes/focus/records and cancelled confirmation
PASS quota sends nothing, server error remains literal in all languages, stale refusal preserves UUID/payload and explicit rereview reveals the current record
PASS language changes during the held real approval preserve locks; lost response/reload/exact retry gives one approval and original reviewer/date with no billing, visits or stock effects
PASS query failure/offline/empty states, attribute-only language change and account change preserve receipts and disable approvals
PASS actual intake: quota prevents POST, all eleven fields survive offline reload, delayed GPS cannot replace newer fields, recovery action visible at 320/390/1440
PASS altered saved data and receipt/cleanup quota failures keep the original request; exact recovery creates one client/pool/task/audit and cleanup does not resend
PASS account changes/late replies, BFCache, cross-tab conflicts and corrupt drafts preserve the account-owned intake

PASS actual ADMIN review: literal fields, offline approval/reload, immutable stale refusal, explicit rereview, lost acknowledgement after client disappears from pending list and exact reviewer confirmation
PASS late ADMIN account change retains only the original reviewer operation; reentry recovers without a second approval

PASS narrow settings, lost response/restart and concurrent retry: one client/pool/task/audit and exact receipt; confirmation survives disabled intake; no credentials/finance projection or unrelated writes
PASS required write failures roll back all creation; validation, authenticated User/leader, policy states and permission guards
PASS stale review produces immutable refusal; failed pool/audit/receipt approval rolls back both resources; lost reply/concurrency keeps one genuine reviewer/audit and first date
PASS existing partial approvals remain visible and can be reconciled atomically with authenticated ADMIN identity; legacy calls remain explicit
PASS preventive plan created through real administration form
PASS technician real preventive completion, calendar advance, immutable execution/history once and refresh without duplicate

verified: Actual administrative page and existing language selector; title/intro, labels, client/pool state, missing fields, links and native confirmation dialogs in five languages at 320/390/1440.
Literal client/pool names, contact details, notes, HTML-like text, braces, zero GPS and decimal volume; no markup execution.

Locale changes preserve element identity/focus, disabled state, all captured records/UUID/payload/hash/failure/receipt fields and local storage; no outbox rereads or operational requests. Only the actual language preference PUT is allowed.
IndexedDB quota sends nothing and preserves the current record; 403 with text resembling an owned session error remains literal.
A genuine intervening pool edit causes INTAKE_APPROVAL_STALE on the same request; its immutable refusal remains literal, and explicit acknowledgement reveals the updated record.

A real approval is committed while its response is held; locale changes keep all approval controls disabled. Returning 503 without an error exercises translated write-store presentation with its Portuguese persisted failure untouched.

Reload and exact UUID/body retry after the lost response recover one approval and one audit. SQL contains exactly two approval receipts: one refusal and one success. Original reviewer/date and pending pool IDs agree.
Previously reviewed inactive pool and full invoice/visit/stock collections remain identical; full client matches original except the exact expected approval fields and updated timestamp.
Query error, offline query, controlled empty read, direct lang attribute change and different-account guard; no cross-account approval.
Unmodified intake browser/API regressions cover offline saved approvals, late accounts, receipt mismatch, restart/concurrent retry, transactional rollback and legacy partial approvals.
Unmodified equipment flow passes with the final application changes; the new engine cannot auto-translate other page sections, and the language test preserves the access-control panel text.
implementation: Private descriptors and leaf bindings repaint captured presentation only; empty article/action containers are not bound.
Owned errors retain Portuguese Error.message and private descriptors; write-store error translations are captured once. Persisted failures and server messages remain literal.

The administrative page previously lacked the global engine. It now loads cw-i18n.js; data-cw-no-i18n protects the page from automatic text translation while the intake panel uses its own explicit bindings. Other administrative panels remain C08 work.
Dates change presentation locale only, keeping the same instant and device timezone.

visual.review: German text wraps within the 320px panel; approval button fits. The existing scroll container shows a scrolled portion of the list. This is not whole-page visual acceptance.
